name: self-switch
description: Lets a session switch its terminal to another conversation on Windows once the current turn ends, for your own use: it checks the other conversation is open nowhere on this machine and nothing runs under this session, then resumes it in place, in the pane's slot, or in a new window. It refuses where the coordinator runs switches.

updateCheck.title: Update check
updateCheck.description: on: when a tool of this plugin is called and the last check is 30 minutes old, fetch this plugin's published plugin.json from GitHub (a plain GET of a public file) and say when a newer version is out. off: never check.

requireCoordinator.title: Require the coordinator
requireCoordinator.description: on: refuse every switch in a session the coordinator plugin hasn't written a gate file for, so a session never switches on its own. off: switch where no coordinator runs; where its gate file says it runs switches, refuse either way.

configDirs.title: Other config folders
configDirs.description: Absolute paths of other Claude Code config folders on this machine (another CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR), whose session registries and transcripts the liveness check also reads. This session's own folder is always read.

heavySlotRoot.title: heavy-slot folder
heavySlotRoot.description: The absolute folder holding heavy-slot.sh's .gate-lock slots, if you use it: a slot whose job runs under this session holds a switch. Empty: none.
